components.html: Who pays what

narrative.overview: The app is the small ruled notebook a household keeps to tally who owes what. Each month is a page, and each housemate is a written line. What they owe is circled in ballpoint, with the working pencilled underneath. Everything the notebook printed is condensed grotesque caps in near-black; everything the user writes is Kalam handwriting in ballpoint blue, sitting on the feint rule. Corrections come only in red pen.
keyCharacteristics: Feint blue rules every 44px, with a double red margin line down the left.
Two voices: printed caps (Archivo, condensed) and ballpoint handwriting (Kalam).
Results amounts are circled by hand-drawn ink rings, and the grand total gets an accountant's double underline.
Red is reserved for corrections: errors, deletions and strike-throughs.
One authored motion: turning to a new page.

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red appears only when something is being corrected or removed. Never use it for emphasis, branding or a primary action.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: User-written data is ballpoint blue, and app-printed furniture is print ink. A value that came from the user must never be set in the printed voice.

rules.name: The Bill Wording Rule
rules.body: Field labels quote the TNB bill exactly: "Total Usage (kWh)" and "Total Bill Amount (RM)".

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the paper casts a shadow. Hierarchy on the page comes from ink, weight, rings and underlines.

dos: Do keep every block in the ruled area to a whole multiple of the 44px rule.
Do write user data in Kalam ballpoint (#1f3fa6) and app furniture in Archivo caps (#1b1f2e / #4b5269).
Do show the arithmetic for every amount in pencil working lines beneath it.
Do strike through removed things (moved-out housemates, a month being deleted) in red rather than making them vanish.
Do keep results screenshot-safe: no element may depend on an animation finishing to be legible.
donts: Don't use red for anything except corrections and removals.
Don't put cards, filled panels or shadows on the paper.
Don't use cream or parchment paper. The page is cool white (#fbfcfe).
Don't set placeholder or body text in Pencil Faint (#a9b0c0); it is for leader dots only.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
